prompt: Camera on the wet tarmac between two lanes of abandoned cars at night, doors flung open, hazard lights all blinking: far down the carriageway a chain of burning cars, the fire leaping from car to car towards the lens. Wide lens, deep focus, the nearest open door huge in the foreground. Firelight the only warm colour. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
